column1: # Model provider catalog. One row per provider the deployment ensures.
# role             the repository name of one model provider. A group member
#                  and a model candidate's provider prefix refer to it.
# magpie provider  the Magpie preset that owns the provider's accounts. The
#                  preset is Magpie's own name for one account type.
# key source       where the credential comes from: codex-account (a ChatGPT
#                  account Magpie reads), env:NAME (a variable in
#                  a JSON store on the device). A json: source is read only.
# required         yes when the provider must exist for the apply to pass, no
#                  when its absence is reported and the apply continues.
# No row carries a credential. A key source names a variable or a path only.
